Generated Narrative: StructureDefinition BeModelEncounter

NameFlagsCard.TypeDescription & Constraints
BeModelEncounter 0..*BaseBeEncounter Model
identifier 1..*IdentifierUnique business identifier of the CareSet
recordedDate 1..1dateTimeDate of registration by the Author/Recorder (date of the last update).
author 1..1Reference()The health professional who takes responsibility for the recorded content
status 1..1codeRegistration status, the moment in the lifecycle. For example: final, corrected, cancelled, entered-in-error. ValueSet: VS_Encounter_Status
class 0..*CodeableConceptClassification of the type of Encounter. ValueSet: VS_Encounter_Class
serviceType 0..*CodeableConceptType of services/specialisation offered during the Encounter. ValueSet: VS_Encounter_ServiceType (see proposal VS_Be_ServiceType_Voorstel)
subject 1..1Reference()The person who is the subject of the healthcare the record (CareSet) refers to. Refers to BePatient
episodeOfCare 0..*Reference()Reference to the EpisodeOfCare resource this Encounter is linked to. Refers to BeEpisodeOfCare
basedOn 0..*Reference()The request that initiated this Encounter. In this case it can only originate from BeCarePlan
careTeam 0..*Reference()Reference to the CareTeam resource recording which team is involved in the care during this Encounter. Refers to BeCareTeam
partOf 0..1Reference()Reference to another Encounter this Encounter is part of. Refers to BeEncounter
serviceProvider 0..1Reference()Organisation responsible for this Encounter. Refers to BeOrganization
participant 0..*BackboneElementList of participants involved in the care during this Encounter. Refers to BePractitioner
period 1..1PeriodPeriod during which the Participant is involved in this Encounter
role 1..1CodeableConceptRole of the Participant involved in this Encounter
actualPeriod 0..1PeriodThe effective start and end moments of this Encounter
length 0..1DurationEffective duration of the Encounter (excluding absences)
reason 0..*CodeableConceptThe list of Reasons that will be discussed during this Encounter. ValueSet: VS_Encounter_Reason
diagnosis 0..*Reference()List of diagnoses relevant for this Encounter. Refers to BeProblem
admission 0..1BackboneElementDetails about the admission of the patient to the care organisation
origin 0..1Reference()The location the patient came from for the admission. Refers to BeOrganization
admitSource 0..1CodeableConceptHow the patient was admitted. ValueSet: VS_Encounter_Admission_AdmitSource
reAdmission 0..1booleanIs this a re-admission of the patient?
destination 0..1Reference()Destination of the patient after discharge. Refers to BeOrganization
dischargeDisposition 0..1CodeableConceptCategory of location after discharge of the patient. ValueSet: VS_Encounter_Admission_DischargeDisposition
note 0..*AnnotationAdditional information related to the CareSet content in free text form

Documentation for this format
